newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dexia Belgium stock to be sold at max 3825 Bfr/shr.
newsitem.headline: Dexia Belgium stock to be sold at max 3825 Bfr/shr.

text.p: A block of up to 15.5 percent of the capital of bank holding company Dexia Belgium will be sold at a maximum price of 3,825 Belgian francs per share, Dexia said in a statement on Friday.
The price corresponds to the share price's close on Friday
Dexia Belgium is the Belgian arm of Belgian-French banking group Dexia, which controls Credit Communal de Belgique (CCB) and Credit Local de France (CLF).
After the June 16 to 23 subscription period, a final price will be announced on June 26, when the shares will start trading on the Brussels bourse.

The shares are being sold by Belgian Holding Communal, itself 100 percent owned by Belgium's municipalities and provinces. Holding Communal sold a first block of Dexia Belgium shares to the public in November 1996, as part of the cross-shareholdership alliance deal with CLF.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
